title: Quantifying Spatial Under-reporting Disparities in Resident Crowdsourcing
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on spatial and socioeconomic disparities in crowdsourced reporting for municipal services.
